basis: Microcephaly, intellectual disability and cervical fusion define disease; ureter anomalies and ptosis each occur in 30-79%. Reticulocyte and dental morphology lack established dysfunction.

decisions.ocular: involved: ptosis represents impaired eyelid function and occurs in 30-79%; proptosis alone would not establish ocular damage.

basis: Lower cranial nerve sheath tumor; compressive hearing impairment occurs in roughly half of patients. Jugular foramen location alone does not establish bone or vascular disease.

decisions.otologic: involved: persistent hearing impairment from tumor compression occurs in approximately 50%, exceeding the frequency threshold.

basis: Cerebellar and axonal degeneration define AOA1; characteristic lipid metabolic dysfunction occurs in 9/12 (~75%). Wasting and skeletal deformities are secondary to neuropathy.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: involved: characteristic lipid metabolic dysfunction with hypercholesterolemia in 9/12 (~75%).
decisions.musculoskeletal: none: amyotrophy (14/14), pes cavus (6/11) and scoliosis (6/12) reflect denervation and secondary deformity rather than direct muscle or bone disease.

basis: Developmental delay in 5/5 and seizures in 3/4 establish neurologic disease. Joint hypermobility in 2/2 lacks demonstrated tissue injury; other organ abnormalities are isolated reports.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: hypermobility in 2/2 does not establish damaging joint dysfunction; isolated skeletal findings do not establish common direct injury.

basis: Inherited lipid metabolism disorder; xanthomas (80-99%) and corneal arcus lack established functional injury. Coronary atherosclerosis is a separate associated disease.

decisions.dermatologic: none: eruptive xanthomas occur in 80-99%, but lipid deposition without established functional skin damage does not satisfy the involvement rule.

basis: Cold-precipitating fibrin proteins cause thrombotic vasculopathy; ischemic skin ulceration or necrosis occurs in roughly half of symptomatic cases. Autoimmunity is not intrinsic.

decisions.cardiovascular: primary: occlusive thrombotic vasculopathy is a defining manifestation of pathogenic cryofibrinogen precipitation.

basis: Neurodevelopmental impairment, parkinsonism and axonal neuropathy define disease. Distal wasting in 2/2 assessed patients reflects denervation; dysphagia reflects neurologic dysfunction.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: distal amyotrophy in 2/2 assessed patients is neurogenic; direct skeletal muscle disease is not established.

basis: Mitochondrial metabolic encephalomyopathy with lactic acidosis and stroke-like episodes. Hearing loss is common in broader MELAS, but ≥30% is not established for MT-ND5 disease.

decisions.otologic: none: broader MELAS hearing-loss frequencies cannot establish ≥30% involvement in this MT-ND5-specific subtype.

basis: Developmental delay affects 31/34. Hypermobility in 9/29 (~31%) lacks demonstrated joint injury; scoliosis affects 3/34. Recurrent infections alone do not establish immunodeficiency.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: hypermobility in 9/29 (~31%) lacks demonstrated damaging dysfunction; scoliosis in 3/34 (~9%) is below threshold.

basis: Congenital bitemporal skin aplasia and atrophic scarring define disease. Distichiasis and absent eyelashes occur in 80-99%, but functional ocular injury is not established.

decisions.ocular: none: frequent eyelash abnormalities do not establish corneal injury or impaired eyelid function in ≥30%; distichiasis alone is insufficient.
